scope: TVL in the explicitly listed Pact protocol components, valued from native state. This registry defines index coverage; it is not a claim to enumerate every application on the network.
snapshot: Canonical final block before the end of each UTC day on each component's chain. The fork date is a partial observation starting at block 6335858.
valuation: Native coin reserves plus non-native reserves valued at the same pool's KDA reserve ratio; standalone deposits valued against the largest native KDA pool on the same chain. No LP receipt token or staking of LP receipts is counted separately. All prices are spot pool-implied valuations, including illiquid assets, not independently realizable sale proceeds.

usdPrice.purpose: KDA/USD display conversion only; never the primary TVL source
usdPrice.convention: Provider's daily close field is its final five-minute OHLC mean for KDA/USDT. USDT is treated as one USD; displayed USD is an estimate. The index scores KDA values only.

protocols.name: Mercatus liquidity pools
protocols.ownership: Each pool account's leg0 and leg1 reserves; fees and LP receipts excluded
protocols.valuation: Two sides of each native KDA pair, with the token leg priced at that pool's reserve ratio
protocols.discovery: All pair-table rows, including pools absent from the public Mercatus API

protocols.name: Mercatus KDX staking
protocols.ownership: staked-kdx field only; burnt KDX, cumulative revenue and LP positions excluded
protocols.valuation: KDX amount times the native Mercatus KDX/KDA reserve ratio

protocols.name: KDSwap liquidity pools
protocols.ownership: Each pool account's two reserves; LP receipts and fee accounts excluded
protocols.valuation: Two sides of each native KDA pair at that pool's reserve ratio

protocols.name: KDLaunch KDL staking
protocols.ownership: totalStaked field only; cumulative rewarded tokens excluded
protocols.valuation: Staked KDL times the native chain-1 KDSwap KDL/KDA reserve ratio

protocols.name: Chips locked tokens
protocols.ownership: Four separate locked token balances; no mining hardware appraisal or reward claims added
protocols.valuation: Each locked token at its native Mercatus KDA pool reserve ratio, including kWATT. Avoids the protocol's stale USD oracle

protocols.name: Kadena Cabinet treasury lock
protocols.ownership: KDA held by the identified Cabinet contract account only

protocols.name: BroDEX open order collateral
protocols.read: Each bro-dex-view-PAIR.get-orderbook, both sides, fully paginated; quote precision read from the quote module
protocols.ownership: Only remaining open-order collateral: asks deposit base amount; bids deposit floor(amount*limitPrice, quotePrecision). Do not also count balances backing wrappers or counterparties' requested assets
protocols.valuation: Deposited side only, priced using contemporaneous native Mercatus pool ratios; bid limit price determines deposited quote amount but does not price the base asset
protocols.escrowEvidence: Every collected order is additionally checked against its actual token balance at the core-generated order-account, guarded by the matching ORDER-ACCOUNT capability. The deployed core create-order checks funding; cancel/take transfer from that account. Any underfunding, unexpected guard or reviewed module-hash change fails the observation.

exclusions.component: LP receipt tokens and LP staking
exclusions.reason: Underlying pool reserves are already counted; counting receipts again would duplicate TVL
Published mainnet configuration marks this market as coming; three named deployed markets are included

exclusions.component: BroDEX unused wrapper deposits and fee accounts
exclusions.reason: Registry measures collateral in open orders; freely withdrawable wallet balances and fees are not additionally classified as locked

Not in this registry version: production collateral accounts and native/non-native backing ownership have not been verified. Wrapped tokens deposited into listed pools are valued once at the pool level
Reviewed public repository is WIP with devnet deployment; no verified mainnet module was identified
Explicitly outside this initial live-protocol registry; legacy DefiLlama adapters marked them inactive before the fork. This exclusion does not assert their residual on-chain balances are zero

exclusions.component: EVM testnet and off-chain custodial exchanges

failurePolicy: Missing historical state, failed reads, unpriced nonzero balances, missing expected pools, duplicate ownership keys, or unverified block hashes fail the observation. They never silently become zero. Registry changes require a new version and consistent historical recomputation.

crossCheck.policy: Cross-check only. Its long zero series and retired adapters cannot replace native observations.
